items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... It’s a real pleasure to have Alvin Queen with us today. [INTERVIEWEE] It’s a pleasure to be here, Monk.

ctx.x: Alvin was interviewed during one of his rare visits to the U.S. on August 23, 1997. The interview took place with Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, at Hamilton College in Clinton.
My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a real pleasure to have Alvin Queen with us today.
It’s a pleasure to be here, Monk.

items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Row, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: it’s a pleasure to be back on one of your programs under your shows.

ctx.x: Alvin was interviewed via Zoom on July 21, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m in Utica, New York talking all the way to Switzerland with Alvin Queen, drummer extraordinaire. Welcome.
Thank you very much. It’s a pleasure to see you again, it’s a pleasure to be back on one of your programs under your shows.
